note: Print Your Own's parts list, as a content pack — the same shape calendar.json uses. Every entry here is Mike's own design; nothing is fabricated placeholder geometry. Status is honest: most of these are in design, not yet printable.

parts.title: Modular Bookends
parts.summary: A pair of bookends built from the Nimrod brick connector system, sized to sit flush on a standard library shelf.

parts.title: Modular Bookshelf
parts.summary: A small shelf unit assembled from the same connector parts as the bookends and the carrying case — one system, three uses.

parts.title: Book-Carrying Case
parts.summary: A case for carrying a small stack of books between a classroom and a makerspace table, built from the same parts.

parts.title: Adaptive Switch Enclosure
parts.summary: The enclosure referenced in Course B and the Maker Monday session: houses an arcade button and a microcontroller as a low-cost adaptive switch. Not designed yet — checked against the repo before writing this, and no build123d source exists for it today.
